widgets_values: r2v — 参考主体生视频(Reference to Video)

模式：Ref2VA | 总时长60秒 | 每段15秒 | 16:9 | 人物锚定：Picture 1

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the male presenter: A hyper-realistic portrait of a tech YouTuber in his 30s, half-body shot, sitting casually on a modern ergonomic chair, set in a high-end tech studio. The background is a stunning wall filled with vintage and modern electronic test equipment — oscilloscopes with glowing green waveforms, spectrum analyzers with colorful frequency displays, digital multimeters, signal generators, and various rack-mounted instruments neatly arranged on industrial metal shelves, soft blue and amber LED indicator lights scattered across the equipment.
﻿
Professional cinematic lighting setup:a clean top key light that wraps around the hair and shoulders, combined with a dramatic left-right split lighting technique — warm light from the left side creating a cozy skin tone, cool cyan/blue light from the right side creating a modern tech atmosphere, subtle rim lights from behind to separate the subject from the background.
﻿
The subject has natural realistic skin texture with visible pores, fine vellus hairs, natural skin imperfections, slight stubble shadow, moisturized lips with natural reflections, realistic subsurface scattering on the ears and nose tip. Wearing a simple well-fitted dark charcoal henley shirt or a black merino wool crewneck sweater, slight smile, confident and approachable expression, looking directly at the camera lens, one hand resting on the desk with a small NAS device or motherboard next to it.
﻿
Photorealistic, 8k resolution, shot on ARRI Alexa 65 with Cooke S7i lenses, f/2.8 shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, natural color grading with teal-orange tone, ultra-detailed, sharp focus on eyes, professional YouTube studio vibe, editorial photography style
﻿
<Picture 1> is fully referenced: the presenter's reference photo.

transform, soft particle dissolve sounds, gentle data-processing whir.

translucent cyan holographic hard drive icon appears, pulsing gently with a
red warning glow around its edge. S1 looks at it briefly with a knowing
expression, then turns back to camera, raising his right hand slightly with
palm open. The hard drive icon splits open, revealing a cluster of small
file icons (photo thumbnails, video clips) spilling out and orbiting around
it. A large red "94%" appears above the drive, glowing brightly. S1 gestures
toward the overflowing files with his left hand, then looks back at camera
with a slight shrug and a helpless smile. The overflowing drive and files
fade. A calm blue "OK" icon appears briefly. S1 lowers his hands, looks
directly at camera with a confident, slightly amused expression.
<d>[Chinese] 最近拍的照片和视频越来越多，电脑硬盘已经快塞满了。一看剩余空间，只剩百分之六。加硬盘吧，现在的价格涨得实在太离谱了。于是我花了点时间研究，找到了一个性价比超高的方案。</d>","negativePrompt":"","taskType":"","refs":[],"refAudios":[],"refVideos":[],"genImage":{"imageFile":"","fileName":""},"continuityFromPrev":false},{"id":"mtefa5fjusy37","start":362,"length":362,"frameCount":362,"durationSec":15,"prompt":"[Shot 2] At 00:15.000 to 00:30.000. Medium shot, static camera. S1 stands
center frame. Behind him, dark blue wall with glowing cyan and amber
instrument panels. To his right, a holographic server rack icon appears,
with "14TB" in bold white digits and "HM-SMR" in smaller amber text below
it. S1 gestures toward it with his right hand, palm open, expression calm
and explanatory. The server rack icon splits into two side-by-side windows.
Left window shows a Windows logo with a red X. Right window shows a Linux
penguin with a green checkmark. A glowing arrow points from the Linux side
to a new window labeled "NAS" in cyan. S1 points at the Linux side with his
left index finger, then traces the arrow to the NAS window, looking slightly
pleased. The left window fades. A new holographic screen appears showing the
"fnOS" logo in bright cyan, with a glowing checkmark beneath it. A network
connection animation arcs from the NAS window to a Mac icon and a Windows
icon on either side. S1 smiles warmly, nods once, and gestures with both
palms open toward the final setup.
<d>[Chinese] 我看中了一种叫 HM-SMR 的服务器硬盘，十四TB的大容量，价格非常合理。但这种盘不能在 Windows 直接用，只能用在 Linux 系统。刚好最近开源的飞牛系统完美支持这种硬盘，做好 NAS 之后，Windows 和 Mac 都能直接共享访问。</d>","negativePrompt":"","taskType":"","refs":[],"refAudios":[],"refVideos":[],"genImage":{"imageFile":"","fileName":""},"continuityFromPrev":true},{"id":"mtefbcfhl81wp","start":724,"length":362,"frameCount":362,"durationSec":15,"prompt":"[Shot 3] At 00:30.000 to 00:45.000. Medium shot, static camera. S1 stands
center frame. Behind him, dark blue wall with glowing instrument panels. To
his right, a holographic film projector icon appears, projecting a beam of
light that spreads into a grid of movie poster thumbnails. Next to it, a
music note icon pulses gently. S1 gestures toward the film icon with his
right hand, expression warm and enthusiastic. The film and music icons fade.
In their place, a holographic AI brain icon appears in a soft amber glow,
with a glowing cyan chat bubble floating beside it. The chat bubble shows a
quick animated typing effect. S1 points at the brain icon with his right
hand, then looks at camera with a slightly raised eyebrow and a knowing
smile. The floating icons all gather into a single small holographic
computer box that gently pulses — representing the final NAS setup. A
glowing "¥130" appears above it in bold. S1 looks at the final display,
smiles confidently, then looks directly at the camera with both hands
gesturing toward the box.
<d>[Chinese] 而且飞牛系统还能帮你打造自己的影视中心，所有电影自动匹配海报和信息。更重要的是，我可以在这上面部署一个 AI 智能体，七天二十四小时的私人助手。研究了一圈发现，一台一百三十块的工控小主机就能跑，算下来性价比真的超高。</d>","negativePrompt":"","taskType":"","refs":[],"refAudios":[],"refVideos":[],"genImage":{"imageFile":"","fileName":""},"continuityFromPrev":true},{"id":"mtefcu5bojg8q","start":1086,"length":362,"frameCount":362,"durationSec":15,"prompt":"[Shot 4] At 00:45.000 to 00:60.000. Medium shot, static camera. S1 stands
center frame. Behind him, dark blue wall with glowing cyan and amber
instrument panels. The small holographic computer box from the previous shot
is still floating gently to his right, pulsing with a soft cyan glow. S1
looks at it briefly, then turns to camera with a warm, slightly eager
expression, rubbing his hands together once. The holographic computer box
expands into a larger translucent screen showing quick abstract visuals: a
motherboard, a screwdriver turning, a blinking cursor on a terminal window
— all fast-floating and swirling into a ring. A glowing white text in the
center reads "DIY START" in bold. S1 gestures toward the screen with his
right hand, palm open, then looks back at camera with a confident nod. The
swirling visuals condense into a single glowing play button icon in cyan,
pulsing gently. S1 lowers his hand, smiles directly at camera with a look
of anticipation, tilting his head slightly as if inviting the viewer to
join him.
<d>[Chinese] 说了这么多，这个方案到底靠不靠谱？下面我们就来实际操作一下，看看这台小主机到底怎么装。从硬件选配到系统安装，踩过的坑和经验，一次全分享给你。</d>","negativePrompt":"","taskType":"","refs":[],"refAudios":[],"refVideos":[],"genImage":{"imageFile":"","fileName":""},"continuityFromPrev":true}],"gen":{"defaultFrameCount":141},"runSelectEnabled":true,"runSelection":[0,1,2,3],"liveTaePreview":true,"batchDetailMode":"all","shots":[{"id":"mteexri3v083p","durationSec":3.3,"prompt":"","negativePrompt":"bad video","startImage":null,"endImage":null}],"keyframes":[{"id":"mteexri3v083p","imageFile":"","width":0,"height":0,"start":0,"length":90,"frameCount":90,"durationSec":3.3,"prompt":"","negativePrompt":"bad video","isStartFrame":true,"isEndFrame":false}]}
